test_ParlaiParser_shortopts: test that ParlaiParser correctly parses short options like -m and -mtw from command line args
test_ParlaiParser_opt_presets: test that ParlaiParser loads and merges opt presets like gen/meena with command line overrides
test_ParlaiParser_parse_kwargs: test that ParlaiParser.parse_kwargs validates kwargs against registered model arguments and raises errors for bad types
test_ParlaiParser_upgrade_opt: test that ParlaiParser upgrades old model options via the upgrade_opt classmethod when loading from a model file
test_add_cmdline_args_partial_opt: test that agents and teachers accept the partial_opt parameter in add_cmdline_args for conditional argument registration
